% 23.03.2023
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 661/2022 dated 08.12.2022 registered at PS Mayur Vihar, Phase-I u/s 376 IPC.

It is stated by Mr. Pahwa, learned senior counsel that in the present case, the date of alleged incident of establishing physical relationship on the false pretext of marriage is of the year October 2015 and lastly in October 2019.
The FIR has been registered on 08.12.2022 i.e. after a delay of more than 7 years of the first incident.
Mr. Pahwa states that in the present case, there was no false promise to marry.
The intention of marriage was present from the inception as even the bare reading of the FIR would demonstrate that the parents of the parties had regularly met to finalise the details of marriage.
It is only on account of non-compatibility that the marriage could not fructify.
Hence, it is not a case of false promise to marry at the inception.
Issue notice.
Ms. Bandhopadhya, learned ASC accepts notice for respondent No. 1.
Let notice be issued to respondent No. 2, on the petitioner taking steps within 1 week from today.
The IO concerned shall also inform the prosecutrix regarding the pendency of the present petition.

sentences.text: This is a petition seeking stay of investigation in FIR No. 661/2022 dated 08.12.2022 registered at PS Mayur Vihar, Phase-I u/s 376 IPC.
In the present case, the first incident of physical relationship is October 2015 and lastly on October 2019, the allegation in the FIR is false promise to marry.
As per the reading of the FIR itself, it seems that the parents of the parties had met to finalise the details of marriage but only on account of non-compatibility, the marriage did not fructify.
Issue notice.
Ms. Bandhopadhya accepts notice for respondent No. 1.
Let notice be issued to respondent No. 2, returnable on 10.04.2023.

Since prima facie it seems to be a case of breach of promise to marry rather than a case of false promise to marry, till the next date of hearing, the applicant shall not be arrested in FIR No.
661/2022 dated 08.12.2022 registered at PS Mayur Vihar u/s 376 IPC, subject to him joining investigation.
JASMEET SINGH, J MARCH 23, 2023/dm
